analysis: Documentation-only change to docs/architecture/prefix-cache.md. Changed head lines: the 'Last updated' date (line 3), the recurrent checkpoint bank gate row (line 295) now includes the 'plain unpublished Nemotron Super owner', and a new paragraph (lines 300-306) describes `alignsRecurrentCheckpointsToPrefillChunks`. Under that flag, Nemotron Super prefill is captured only at multiples of its fixed prefill chunk reached by whole chunks, so a restored request runs the same chunk partition as a cold one. Relevant to T-041 (cross-tenant prefix-cache sharing and TTFT oracle) and TB-007. The documented behavior concerns the opt-in resident bank, which requires DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_MEMORY=1. The doc says the bank is bound to the loaded model instance, model ID, prompt contract and build identity, and separated by an authenticated cacheSalt. The doc says this bank writes nothing to disk. The change does not alter at-rest encryption, HMAC lookup tags, TTL, the SSD tier or the routing scope. It adds no new endpoint or trust boundary. No source code changed in this unit, so I could not verify that the Nemotron Super owner (`NemotronSuperLocalPrefixCache`) enforces the same cacheSalt, identity and budget bindings. I treat that as an unverified contract, not a finding. The excerpt of the unchanged SSD and resident sections shows no contradiction with T-041. Later passes that see code changes should check that a Nemotron Super resident bank honors cacheSalt tenant isolation and the slot KV grant accounting.
